question_text:
Passage: The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) recently unveiled a comprehensive plan to improve government service delivery across all local government units (LGUs). The plan, called 'Serbisyo Muna,' focuses on three pillars: streamlining bureaucratic processes, enhancing digital infrastructure, and training frontline personnel. Under the streamlining pillar, the DILG aims to reduce the average processing time for business permits from 15 days to 5 days by 2026. The digital infrastructure pillar includes the establishment of a unified online portal for all LGU transactions, while the training pillar mandates a 40-hour customer service seminar for all government employees. The plan also introduces a feedback mechanism where citizens can rate their service experience via SMS or a mobile app. According to DILG Secretary Maria Reyes, 'This is not just about efficiency; it's about restoring trust in government.'

What is the author's primary purpose in writing this passage?

options.text: To criticize the DILG for not doing enough
To inform readers about a new government plan
To persuade readers to support the plan
To entertain readers with a story about government
